messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Primary GPU pool (region: eu-west-1, pool: primary-gpu-v2) saturated and autoscaler failing to converge. Queue length rising rapidly. Triggering incident channel.

sre-oncall-maya: seeing huge backlog on the primary queue, tail latencies spiking. 429s and 503s in the proxy logs. Paging runtime and infra.

runtime-oncall-dan: thanks - pulling logs. autoscaler reports 'scale_up_failed: quota_exceeded' for the region. Also seeing repeated OOMs on warmup pods, looks like a config mismatch in the new instance type.

infra-liam: quota_exceeded means cloud quota limit on GPUs for eu-west-1 is at play. I can request quota but that's slow. For immediate mitigation we can: 1) shift routing to other regions 2) enable burst capacity in dedicated pool 3) drop to quantized model fallback. Which do we want?

prod-eng-anita: impact: customers reporting slow or failed completions. Early telemetry shows high error rate for some high-throughput customers (approx 6 customers with >50% errors). We should notify CS/AMs once we have a mitigation plan.

solutions-ops-jess: adding context: two enterprise customers have region pins for compliance (eu-only). They will be impacted if we spill them to other regions. Need consent before cross-region steer for them.

runtime-oncall-dan: mitigation plan attempt 1: disable regional pinning for non-enterprise routes and enable geo-steer to west-1/west-2 for best-effort routes. Patch to routing service sent:```
POST /admin/routing/steer
{
  "selector": "!enterprise_pin",
  "fallback_regions": ["us-west-2","eu-north-1"],
  "priority": "lowest-latency"
}
```

sre-oncall-maya: executing manual reroute now. Will also enable token-level throttling to protect control plane: set rate limit for high-volume keys to 20rps.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing/steer-v1 -> canary on router-nodes (5/5 success).

infra-liam: manual patch applied to pool config to temporarily allow the dedicated-burst pool to accept 20% extra ephemeral jobs. This should reduce queue by offloading short requests.

prod-eng-anita: can we also fallback to a smaller quantized model for non-critical routes to reduce GPU memory? That buys headroom.

runtime-oncall-dan: yes - flip model-fallback tag for model family gpt-rl -> gpt-rl-quant. Pushed a rollout:```
sh ./ops/rollout_fallback.sh --selector "!enterprise_pin" --model gpt-rl-quant
```

sre-oncall-maya: watching queue metrics. backlog peaked ~11k requests, currently trending down to ~3.9k after reroute + burst. Token cost note: quantized fallback increases variance in output; inform quality team.

solutions-ops-jess: contacting two pinned-enterprise customers via AMs to request temporary geo-redirect permission. If they deny, we need to keep them in eu-west-1 and prioritize them on the remaining capacity.

prod-eng-anita: CS notified. Putting a status note for affected customers: increased error rates and latencies for api/generate in eu-west-1. ETA for mitigation: unknown but best-effort reroute started.

runtime-oncall-dan: tracing a failure pattern: autoscaler retry loop fails because instance type x1-gpu-v2 was recently flagged for deprecation and the pool config referenced it; new instances are not coming up. Rolling a config patch to use supported instance type x2-gpu-v1.```
kubectl patch cm -n runtime autoscaler-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/instance_type","value":"x2-gpu-v1"}]'

infra-liam: applied, starting a rolling restart of autoscaler agents. Note: this requires a brief controller outage (~20s) — done.

sre-oncall-maya: autoscaler now reporting successful launches in eu-west-1. However cloud quota still prevents full scale to requested size. We'll continue spillover for best-effort traffic.

prod-eng-anita: status update for ops channel: mitigations in place: cross-region spillover for non-pinned traffic, dedicated-burst enabled, quantized fallback enabled. Partial recovery observed. Customer-facing status draft: "Partial service degradation in EU region; mitigation underway; some customers may experience higher errors or be redirected to alternate regions."

solutions-ops-jess: enterprise customer A (ID: C-4582) approved geo-redirect for the next 2 hours. Enterprise customer B declined. Marking B for priority scheduling on remaining eu capacity.

runtime-oncall-dan: queue down to ~900 requests. Error rate dropping to baseline for non-pinned routes. Still seeing 5 enterprise requests queued in eu-west-1 for customer B.

sre-oncall-maya: executing final step: increase priority for pinned enterprise B routes to preempt low-priority queued work. Command:```
POST /admin/queue/priority
{ "customer_id": "C-000B", "priority": "high" }
```

prod-eng-anita: OK. Customer B's critical requests are now green — their SLA requests are going through. Continue to monitor.

runtime-oncall-dan: starting postmortem capture: root cause candidates: 1) region GPU quota exhaustion 2) autoscaler config referencing deprecated instance type causing launch failures 3) routing policy lacked sufficient non-enterprise spillover capacity. We'll capture evidence and TL;DR for execs.

sre-oncall-maya: paging follow-ups: I will stay on for watch window +30m. Dan, please capture exact timestamps and config diffs. Liam, open a quota increase ticket with cloud provider and tag as high-priority. Jess, coordinate customer comms.

infra-liam: quota ticket opened: TICKET-CLD-99827 (cloud response ETA 18-24 hours). Also filing infra action: reserve warm capacity in eu-west-1 to avoid future cold-launch OOMs.

solutions-ops-jess: notifying AMs and creating short customer note.

prod-eng-anita: impact summary for postmortem: affected routes: api/generate (eu-west-1), duration: ~00:42 from detection to substantial recovery, severity: P2 (multiple customers affected, no data loss).

incidents-bot: Incident state changed -> mitigated. Runbook: responders remain for watch until 2244669830.

sre-oncall-maya: ack. will compile timeline and open a postmortem doc. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
